notes: Descriptions are English summaries of the bilingual (Chinese/English) tool descriptions. wraps_endpoint is filled only when the description names an endpoint or internal step. Account/shop/order values are redacted; catalogue and freight values kept. Samples in cj_mcp_samples/.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Adds an already-created CJ order to the cart (step 2 only, addCart); no confirmation or payment. For the full pipeline use submit_order_to_cart.

tools.name: calculate_freight
tools.description: Freight estimate by destination country, weight and logistics method, for product cost evaluation and price comparison.

params.name: products
params.description: Product list; needs variant ids from search_products.

params.name: taxId
params.description: Recipient tax id (e.g. EU IOSS) for cross-border tax calculation.

tools.name: calculate_freight_tip
tools.description: Enhanced freight trial that can filter shipping options by platform (Shopify/WooCommerce etc.). Requires origin, destination, logistics property and weight.

params.name: productProp
params.description: Logistics properties from get_product_detail productProEnSet, e.g. ["COMMON"].

params.name: freightTrialSkuList
params.description: Recommended: SKUs with quantity and weight/volume.

params.name: platforms
params.description: Filter shipping options by platform (shopify, ebay, amazon, tiktok, etsy).

params.name: totalGoodsAmount
params.description: Total goods value USD (customs declaration and IOSS).

params.name: houseNumber
params.description: House number (some carriers need a precise address).

response_fields.example_or_redacted: Please enter your postcode (only numbers, symbols and spaces are supported).
Please enter your postcode (only numbers, symbols and spaces are supported).

tools.name: cancel_dispute
tools.description: [Sensitive, needs user confirmation] Withdraws a dispute after the issue is resolved or agreed.

tools.name: check_login_status
tools.description: Reports whether the CJ account is connected/authorized, by which method, and what to do if not. Read-only; never returns credential material.

response_fields.example_or_redacted: URL direct token (stateless, no server storage)

tools.name: configure_webhook
tools.description: [Sensitive] Sets the HTTPS callback URL and enables/disables product, stock, order and logistics event pushes. Each call overwrites the whole config; omitted types reset to ENABLE. Callback must be public HTTPS.

tools.name: confirm_cart_and_pay
tools.description: [Sensitive] For an order already in the cart: confirms cart (addCartConfirm), generates the parent payment order (saveGenerateParentOrder) and returns a payment link.

params.name: orderId
params.description: CJ order ID already in cart.

tools.wraps_endpoint: addCartConfirm + saveGenerateParentOrder (internal step names per description)
tools.safety_note: Creates a payment order and link; does not itself debit funds.

tools.name: confirm_dispute
tools.description: Step 2 of opening a dispute: returns available dispute reasons, expected-result options (1 refund, 2 reissue) and maximum refund amount for create_dispute. Description states it is a query that creates/modifies nothing.
tools.safety_note: Despite the name, described as query-only. Not called (no orders).

tools.name: confirm_order
tools.description: [Sensitive] Confirms an order and triggers payment; irreversible, deducts account balance. Must tell the user before calling.

tools.name: create_dispute
tools.description: [Sensitive, not freely reversible] Step 3: submits a dispute. Must call get_dispute_products then confirm_dispute and let the user pick reason/outcome first. expectType 1 refund / 2 reissue; refundType 1 balance / 2 original platform.

params.name: videoUrl
params.description: Evidence video URLs (upload via /disputes/uploadFile first if links expire).

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Creates a CJ order (V2). All required fields must be supplied at once with exact field names. payType 2 pays from balance immediately; isSandbox=1 creates a sandbox order with no real charge.

params.name: orderInfo
params.description: Order parameters (field names must match exactly).

items.name: shippingCountry
items.description: Full country name, e.g. United States.

items.name: payType
items.description: 1 page payment (default), 2 pay from balance, 3 create only.

items.name: shopLogisticsType
items.description: 1 platform logistics, 2 merchant (default), 3 CJ assigned warehouse.

items.name: orderFlow
items.description: 1 manual order flow, 2 store order flow.

tools.wraps_endpoint: createOrderV2 (per description: 'Create order (V2)'; submit_order_to_cart refers to createOrderV2)
tools.safety_note: With payType=2 it also spends balance (financial).

tools.name: create_product_connection
tools.description: [Sensitive] Binds CJ product variants to a store's platform product variants so store orders auto-match to CJ for fulfilment.

tools.name: create_sourcing
tools.description: Submits a sourcing request asking CJ to find/procure a product (name + image URL required). Returns cjSourcingId for query_sourcing. Not a catalogue search.

tools.name: delete_order
tools.description: [Sensitive] Soft-deletes an order (status becomes TRASH; still listed). Only CREATED or IN_CART orders; no restore tool in MCP.

tools.name: diagnose_shipping_methods
tools.description: Explains why each shipping method is unavailable on a route. Use only when calculate_freight_tip returns fewer/no methods. Returns no prices; costlier per call; troubleshooting only.

params.name: productProp
params.description: Logistics properties from productProEnSet; missing fails with 1600300.

params.name: shippingMode
params.description: 1 platform logistics (platforms then required), 2 merchant logistics; downstream default 2 (except AliExpress).

params.name: platforms
params.description: Required when shippingMode=1 (tiktok_us, tiktok_us_cross, Temu, Temu_us_local, Temu_certified_overseas, shein).

tools.name: disconnect_product
tools.description: [Sensitive] Removes the binding between a platform product variant and a CJ product; one call per platformVariantId.

tools.name: generate_payment_link
tools.description: [Sensitive] From a shipmentsId (after addCartConfirm), generates the parent payment order (saveGenerateParentOrder) and returns payId and payment URL.
tools.safety_note: Creates a payment order; money moves only when it is paid.

tools.name: get_account_balance
tools.description: Returns CJ account balance: available, frozen and bonus amounts in USD.
tools.safety_note: Financial information; deliberately not called in this audit.

tools.name: get_account_settings
tools.description: Returns static account config: openId, openName, openEmail, per-endpoint quotaLimits, qpsLimit and webhook callback config. Does not return remaining quota (use get_rate_limit_status). quotaLimit=-1 means no per-endpoint cap.

response_fields.example_or_redacted: redacted (API already returns it partly masked)

tools.name: get_authorize_url
tools.description: Returns a shop authorization URL for connecting a new e-commerce store to the CJ account.

tools.name: get_category_tree
tools.description: Returns the CJ product category tree (top categories such as Clothing, Electronics, Home) for filtering searches.

params.name: parentId
params.description: Parent category id; omit for top level.

tools.name: get_dispute_detail
tools.description: Dispute detail: status, refund amount, product list.

tools.name: get_dispute_products
tools.description: Step 1 of opening a dispute: lists an order's disputable products with lineItemId, price, quantity.

tools.name: get_logistics_timeliness
tools.description: Estimated delivery time and available shipping methods from origin to destination country.

params.name: weight
params.description: Total weight grams, integer >= 1 (fractions rejected upstream).

tools.call_result: error: Timeliness query failed: Too Many Requests, QPS limit is 1 time/1second (sent in the same instant as calculate_freight and calculate_freight_tip; not retried because the brief allows a retry only for parameter mistakes)

tools.name: get_merge_progress
tools.description: Polls progress of an asynchronous order-merge task.

tools.name: get_my_products
tools.description: Lists products the user has added to 'My Products' (not a full catalogue search); keyword and time filters.

tools.name: get_order_detail
tools.description: Full detail of one CJ order: status, shipping address, products, logistics (trackNumber), amounts. Data only; show_order_detail renders UI.

params.name: orderId
params.description: CJ order id or custom order id.

tools.name: get_order_list
tools.description: Order list query (data only; show_order_list renders UI; do not chain both).

tools.name: get_pay_order_list
tools.description: Unpaid / pending-payment orders only.

tools.name: get_platform_category_attributes
tools.description: Attributes (item specifics) of a store platform category, including required ones and allowed values, for publishing.

tools.name: get_platform_child_categories
tools.description: Child categories of the shop's platform (eBay/Shopee/Lazada/TikTok/Temu/Mercado/WooCommerce...) level by level, for publishing.

params.name: parentCategoryId
params.description: Parent category id; omit or 0 for top level.

params.name: cjProductId
params.description: CJ product id (recommendation on some platforms).

tools.call_result: error: Get platform child categories failed: Store not found or Authorization Failed. Please reauthorize your store before syncing again. (shopId of the Shopify-type shop)

tools.name: get_product_detail
tools.description: Full product detail: names, images, price, variants, description, logistics properties, customs code. Data only; show_product_detail renders UI. One of pid/productSku/variantSku required.

params.name: countryCode
params.description: Only variants with stock in this country.

response_fields.example_or_redacted: Jewelry & Watches > Fashion Jewelry > Necklace & Pendants

tools.name: get_product_inventory
tools.description: Inventory of a product across countries and sub-warehouses per variant; stockId can be passed to get_storage_info.

tools.name: get_product_reviews
tools.description: Buyer reviews (score, text, images) for a product; filter by score, paged.

tools.name: get_product_variants
tools.description: All variants (colour/size) with price, weight, image. One of pid/productSku/variantSku.

params.name: countryCode
params.description: Only variants in stock in this country.

tools.name: get_rate_limit_status
tools.description: Live rate-limit and remaining-quota status of this MCP service: QPS tiers (read/write/auth/global), daily quota used/remaining, concurrency and queue.

tools.name: get_storage_info
tools.description: Detail of one CJ warehouse (address, contact, logistics brands, self-pickup) by storage UUID from get_order_detail or get_product_inventory stockId. Not for listing warehouses.
tools.call_result: error: Get storage info failed: Warehouse info not found (storageId 6709CCD7-0DC7-43B1-B310-17AB499E9B0A, a factory sub-warehouse stockId from get_product_inventory)

tools.name: get_tracking_info
tools.description: Real-time tracking for one or more tracking numbers: status, location, ETA.

tools.name: get_warehouses
tools.description: List of CJ global warehouse regions (country level) with ids for filtering private inventory; ids are region ids, not storage UUIDs.

response_fields.example_or_redacted: สหรัฐอเมริกา

tools.name: list_disputes
tools.description: Lists ongoing and finished disputes.

tools.name: list_product_connections
tools.description: Lists CJ-to-platform product connection records; filter by shop/platform product/variant.

tools.name: list_shops
tools.description: Lists authorized stores (Shopify/WooCommerce/eBay etc.).

tools.name: merge_orders
tools.description: Auto-matches mergeable orders into groups to save shipping (batch order optimisation). Paired with get_merge_progress, which polls an asynchronous merge task.

params.name: filterOrder
params.description: true filters manually removed orders (default), false includes all.

tools.safety_note: Conservative class: description says it returns mergeable groups, but merging is described as an async operation; may alter orders.

tools.name: open_listing_page
tools.description: Opens the product page on CJ with the listing modal auto-triggered (?list=1). productId must come from search_products/query_sku_details.

tools.name: open_order_page
tools.description: Generates an order page URL to finish a complex order in the browser (variants, address, payment).

tools.name: open_product_connect_page
tools.description: Opens the product page with the store-connect flow auto-triggered (?connect=1).

tools.name: open_shopping_cart
tools.description: Generates the shopping cart page URL.

tools.name: pay_by_balance
tools.description: [Sensitive, real money, irreversible] Pays a single order from account balance (payBalance). Must first show order amount and balance and get explicit confirmation.

tools.name: pay_by_balance_v2
tools.description: [Sensitive, real money, irreversible] Pays a parent/shipment order from balance (payBalanceV2) using shipmentOrderId + payId from saveGenerateParentOrder.

tools.name: publish_product_async
tools.description: [Sensitive] Asynchronously lists a CJ product in an authorized store (Shopify/WooCommerce/Lazada/Shopee/TikTok/Whop/Nuvemshop/AliExpress/Mercado/Temu); not idempotent. Returns listedId; poll query_publish_status.

params.name: variants
params.description: Variants to list, 1-200; each needs variantId and price (variant ids from get_product_variants).

items.name: sku
items.description: Variant SKU; defaults to CJ variant SKU.

items.name: shippingCost
items.description: Shipping cost USD from freight trial.

params.name: images
params.description: Images {url, position}; Etsy and other Rutter-based platforms max 5.

params.name: categoryId
params.description: Platform category id (from get_platform_child_categories; product_type for Shopify).

params.name: productCategoryAttributes
params.description: Category attributes (TikTok/Temu/Shopee/Mercado/AliExpress) {platformAttributeId, platformAttributeName, attributeValueList[]} from get_platform_category_attributes.

params.name: attributes
params.description: eBay item specifics / Lazada attributes {attributeId, attributeName, attributeValueId, attributeValue}.

params.name: platformBrandId
params.description: Platform brand id (from query_platform_brands; vendor for Shopify).

params.name: enableLogisticsFee
params.description: Shopify: include shipping cost in price; false means variant shipping counted as 0.

params.name: logisticsWay
params.description: Logistics method name (logisticName from freight trial).

params.name: publishPriceCurrency
params.description: Selling price currency; query_shop_publish_info gives the shop currency.

params.name: shopCurrency
params.description: eBay site currency (e.g. GBP for UK); eBay only.

params.name: needUploadImgOptionName
params.description: Option name whose values carry images (required by TikTok).

params.name: platformShippingServiceType
params.description: eBay shipping service type (required by eBay).

params.name: sellPrice
params.description: Mercado selling price, same for all variants (required by Mercado).

params.name: deliveryTime
params.description: Promised handling time (Temu semi-managed in seconds, Temu US Local in days).

tools.name: publish_product_sync
tools.description: [Sensitive] Synchronously lists a CJ product in an authorized store (eBay/Etsy/BigCommerce/Squarespace/Magento/PrestaShop/Wix/Shoplazza/AllValue); not idempotent. Returns the platform product link.

params.name: variants
params.description: Variants to list, 1-200; each needs variantId and price (variant ids from get_product_variants).

items.name: sku
items.description: Variant SKU; defaults to CJ variant SKU.

items.name: shippingCost
items.description: Shipping cost USD from freight trial.

params.name: images
params.description: Images {url, position}; Etsy and other Rutter-based platforms max 5.

params.name: categoryId
params.description: Platform category id (from get_platform_child_categories; product_type for Shopify).

params.name: productCategoryAttributes
params.description: Category attributes (TikTok/Temu/Shopee/Mercado/AliExpress) {platformAttributeId, platformAttributeName, attributeValueList[]} from get_platform_category_attributes.

params.name: attributes
params.description: eBay item specifics / Lazada attributes {attributeId, attributeName, attributeValueId, attributeValue}.

params.name: platformBrandId
params.description: Platform brand id (from query_platform_brands; vendor for Shopify).

params.name: enableLogisticsFee
params.description: Shopify: include shipping cost in price; false means variant shipping counted as 0.

params.name: logisticsWay
params.description: Logistics method name (logisticName from freight trial).

params.name: publishPriceCurrency
params.description: Selling price currency; query_shop_publish_info gives the shop currency.

params.name: shopCurrency
params.description: eBay site currency (e.g. GBP for UK); eBay only.

params.name: needUploadImgOptionName
params.description: Option name whose values carry images (required by TikTok).

params.name: platformShippingServiceType
params.description: eBay shipping service type (required by eBay).

params.name: sellPrice
params.description: Mercado selling price, same for all variants (required by Mercado).

params.name: deliveryTime
params.description: Promised handling time (Temu semi-managed in seconds, Temu US Local in days).

tools.name: query_cj_inventory
tools.description: CJ public (non-private) inventory by vid, sku/SPU or pid; per-warehouse totalInventoryNum/cjInventoryNum/factoryInventoryNum.

tools.name: query_cogs
tools.description: Cost-of-goods data for orders: goods amount, freight, tax breakdown.

tools.name: query_platform_brands
tools.description: Brand list of the shop's platform (needed for TikTok/Lazada/AliExpress listings); needNoBrand=true adds a 'No brand' option.
tools.call_result: error: Query platform brands failed: Store not found or Authorization Failed. Please reauthorize your store before syncing again. (shopId of the Shopify-type shop)

tools.name: query_private_inventory
tools.description: Your own stock bought and stored in CJ warehouses (SPU list); not the public catalogue.

tools.name: query_publish_status
tools.description: Listing result by listedId or shopId+productId (PRODUCT_STAY/CENTRE keep polling >=5 s; SUCCESS has platformProductUrl; FAIL has listedFailMessage).

tools.name: query_shop_publish_info
tools.description: Shop listing info: currency, listing quota, and whether a product is already listed there. Call before publishing.

tools.name: query_sku_detail_by_sku
tools.description: Private-inventory SKU detail (inbound batches, notes) by exact variant SKU. For public stock use query_cj_inventory.

tools.name: query_sku_detail_page
tools.description: Paged SKU detail list (private inventory) for products with many SKUs.

tools.name: query_sku_details
tools.description: Private-inventory SKU details for a product: variant quantities and warehouse distribution.

tools.name: query_sourcing
tools.description: Looks up sourcing requests by id (listing all is not supported upstream).
tools.call_result: error: Please provide sourceIds. Upstream does not support listing all sourcing requests; query by ID only (called with sourceIds=[] since none exist)

tools.name: query_warehouse_order_pictures
tools.description: Warehouse photos taken while processing orders (packing, inbound).

tools.name: republish_product
tools.description: [Sensitive] Retries a failed listing record (PRODUCT_FAIL only, batch-capable platforms); creates the product in the store again.

tools.name: save_product_to_shop
tools.description: [Sensitive] Saves/syncs a store product's info into CJ, linking it with CJ.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Searches the existing CJ catalogue with keyword, category, price, country, warehouse and other filters (data only; show_product_list renders UI). Not for sourcing requests or private stock.

params.name: countryCode
params.description: Only products with stock in this country (US, CN, GB, DE, FR...).

params.name: isWarehouse
params.description: true = global-warehouse products only; combine with countryCode.

params.name: startWarehouseInventory
params.description: Minimum warehouse inventory (>=1); only in-stock products by default.

params.name: addMarkStatus
params.description: Free shipping filter: 0 not free, 1 free.

params.name: productType
params.description: listV2 string format: ORDINARY_PRODUCT or SUPPLIER_PRODUCT.

params.name: zonePlatform
params.description: Platform zone filter: shopify, ebay, amazon, tiktok, etsy, walmart, etc.

params.name: features
params.description: Extra data: enable_description, enable_category, enable_combine, enable_video (video ids).

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Sort field: 0 best match, 1 listed count, 2 price, 3 create time, 4 inventory.

tools.wraps_endpoint: product listV2 (productType description says 'listV2 API uses string format')

tools.name: show_order_detail
tools.description: UI tool, read-only: renders one order's detail in an MCP Apps panel (fetches by orderId itself).

tools.name: show_order_list
tools.description: UI tool: renders the order list as cards (fetches itself).

tools.name: show_product_detail
tools.description: UI tool: renders one product's detail with images and variants (fetches by pid itself).

tools.name: show_product_list
tools.description: UI tool: renders a product list as cards with search/paging (fetches by keyword itself).

tools.name: submit_order_to_cart
tools.description: [Sensitive] From a created orderId runs addCart -> addCartConfirm -> saveGenerateParentOrder and returns a payment link.
tools.wraps_endpoint: addCart + addCartConfirm + saveGenerateParentOrder (internal step names per description)
tools.safety_note: Creates a payment order and link; does not itself debit funds.
